intro.title: Measure your CV against one job.
intro.lede: One posting, one PDF. The verdict is back in seconds.

role.title: The role
role.body: The company and the job title name this analysis, and later set the scene for the practice interview.

posting.title: The posting
posting.body: Paste all of it: requirements, responsibilities, nice-to-haves. Every requirement is read from this text, so the fuller the posting, the more precise the read.

cv.title: Your CV
cv.body: A PDF with a text layer, not a scan: it's read the way an applicant tracking system (ATS) reads it. It stays attached to the analysis so you can open it again.

form.idle: Runs while you wait · usually under 20 seconds
form.quota_one: {{left}} of {{count}} analysis left this month · resets {{date}}
form.quota_other: {{left}} of {{count}} analyses left this month · resets {{date}}
form.proOffer: With Pro you get up to {{limit}} analyses a month.

failure.kept: Everything you entered is still here, your file included.

file.replace: Click or drop another PDF to replace it.
file.dropOrChoose: Drop your CV here, or click to choose it

rejected.tooLarge: That file is over {{size}}. Export it again with compressed images and upload that.
rejected.tooMany: Drop one file at a time.

uploading.title: Upload
uploading.detail: Your PDF goes to private storage · {{size}}

analyzing.title: Analysis
analyzing.detail: Runs on our server as one request and comes back all at once, when it's done.

opening.title: Your analysis
opening.detail: Opens on its own page as soon as it's saved.

now.title: What happens now
now.body: Your PDF's text layer is read the way an applicant tracking system (ATS) reads it. The posting's requirements are listed, each with the phrase it came from, and each one is looked for in your CV. It usually takes under 20 seconds.

run.slow: This one is taking longer than usual. It's still running.
run.keepOpen: Keep this tab open until your analysis opens.
